# JD: Influencer Marketing Manager

**Can you help us fix the world's most broken supply chain?**

The fashion industry produces over 100 billion garments a year. 60% end up in landfill, not because people don't want these clothes, but because the supply chain for getting secondhand fashion from donation to resale is completely offline, manual, and broken.

Fleek is fixing this. Our mission is to make secondhand the first choice. We're building the infrastructure powering the global secondhand clothing trade, through a B2B marketplace and the AI systems digitising the supply chain behind it.

Through Fleek, vintage stores, online resellers, and retail buyers source graded secondhand inventory directly from wholesalers and rag houses across multiple countries. Our key enabler is FleekSort, an AI model fine-tuned on secondhand fashion, that can grade, price, and categorise items with just a photo, turning what has historically been an opaque and manual trade into a structured, searchable, and tradable global inventory layer.

Since 2022, we've saved 9 million items from landfill while tripling in size year-on-year. We're backed by some of the world's best investors, including a16z, Y Combinator, and HV Capital, alongside world-class angels who helped build Depop, Shopify, and Postmates.

Today, we serve thousands of resellers and retailers across the UK, Europe, and the US. With the secondhand fashion market projected to reach $350B by 2027, Fleek is building the AI-native operational and financial backbone for secondhand commerce globally.

We're looking for people who want to build something that matters, and move fast doing it. Sound good? Keep reading.

## About the Role

Influencer is Fleek's best acquisition channel. Resellers buy from people they trust, and creators convert where ads don't: influencer-sourced buyers are consistently among our highest-value customers. Over the past two years we've built a 1,000+ creator roster across TikTok, YouTube, and Instagram, with recruitment already largely automated.

The next chapter is keep scaling recruiting while activating better at scale: keeping a large roster posting every month, pointing the channel at our highest-value buyers (hobbyist and pro resellers in the UK and France), and running it all on a Content Brain, our internal AI system that profiles every partner and generates personalised campaign briefs.

This is a role with full channel ownership. You set the strategy, run the campaigns, manage the budget, and own the number. You'll report into the Growth team and work alongside community & organic social, performance marketing, and data.

## Why This Role Stands Out

**You'll run a portfolio, not a gifting program.** Most influencer roles are about landing partnerships. Ours is about operating a system: hundreds of partners segmented by tier, channel, geo, and niche; multiple concurrent campaigns per month; tiered budgets with weekly performance-based reallocation. It's closer to running a trading desk than sending PR packages.

**It's AI-native, for real.** We want partner profiling, brief generation, and campaign personalisation run on our Content Brain. Post performance feeds back into the system to sharpen the next round. You'll run many segmented campaigns concurrently without scaling headcount, and you'll help design what the engine does next.

**It's a headline bet, not a side project.** Trust channels (influencer + referral) are the company's named acquisition strategy for H2, with real budget behind them, hero campaigns to mobilise, and a community flywheel (Discord, UGC, ambassadors) being built around your channel.

## What You'll Own

**The number.** New hobbyist and pro buyers via the influencer channel. Channel-level CAC, payback, and first-order AOV. You'll report results in our weekly business review.

**Activation.** The # and % of partners posting each month is the headline metric. You'll run a segmented campaign calendar — by tier (mega → nano), channel (TikTok / YouTube / Instagram), geo (UK / France), niche, and lifecycle — with dedicated re-activation campaigns for dormant partners.

**The campaign engine.** AI-generated, segment- and partner-specific briefs on Content Brain: hook, format, full CTA stack, do's and don'ts, reference examples. You'll codify what works into the system and close the loop from post performance back into the next brief.

**Recruitment mix.** Scale YouTube and Instagram against the reseller ICP — quality over headcount, with the customer:influencer ratio trending up. YouTube is our compounding channel: content lives forever and drives our best buyers.

**Budget discipline.** Tiered gifting and incentive structures, per-campaign test budgets and caps, and weekly reallocation toward the best-CAC segments. A portfolio of small bets, doubling down on winners.

**Core partner relationships.** Long-term contracts and high-touch management of the top creators who drive most of the volume, plus creator activations for our 2–3 hero campaigns each half.

**The community bridge.** Keep the influencer programme wired into the wider flywheel: the Discord community (UK + France), the UGC engine, giveaways, events, and the referral loop.

## How You'll Work

**AI-forward by default.** You use LLMs and agents daily to multiply your output: briefs, outreach, reporting, monitoring. You'd rather build a workflow than repeat a task.

**Performance-led.** Every campaign ships with a hypothesis, a budget cap, and a kill-or-scale decision. You're measured on buyers and payback, not reach.

**A relationship builder.** You cultivate long-term creator partnerships, not transactional one-off sponsorships. Creators should want to work with Fleek because of you.

**Autonomous.** There's no influencer expert above you to set direction. You'll get context, data access, an AI engine, and budget. The strategy is yours to defend.

## What We're Looking For

- 4–7 years in influencer, creator, or partnerships marketing with direct ownership of an acquisition number, ideally in a marketplace, e-commerce, or consumer business.
- A track record running always-on creator programmes at scale (hundreds of partners), not just one-off brand campaigns.
- Strong performance fluency: CAC, payback, AOV, attribution. Comfortable in dashboards and spreadsheets, and honest about what's working.
- Native fluency in TikTok, YouTube, and Instagram creator ecosystems. Bonus points for resale, fashion, or the reseller community specifically.
- Hands-on experience with gifting, affiliate, and referral mechanics, creator contracts, and negotiation.
- You use AI daily and are excited to run a channel on top of AI systems rather than a spreadsheet and a prayer.
- Bonus: French language skills or France market experience — France is our flagship community market.

## This Role Isn't for You If You Want

- To brief an agency and review decks. Here you run the engine yourself.
- To be measured on reach and impressions. You'll be measured on buyers, CAC, and payback.
- A big team under you from day one. Your leverage comes from AI systems, not headcount.
- Fully remote work. This team is in London 4 days per week.

## The Practicalities

- **Location:** London HQ, Commercial St, E1 (Liverpool St / Aldgate East)
- **Work model:** Hybrid, 4 days per week on-site
- **Stage:** Post-Series B, hyper-growth
- **Team:** 100+ across London, India, and Pakistan
- **Reports to:** Growth & Marketing
- **Culture:** High ownership, non-hierarchical, fast-moving. Founder-led with strong opinions loosely held.

## Why People Join Fleek

- **The problem is real:** 9 million items saved from landfill since 2022. Your work has tangible, measurable impact.
- **The AI is genuinely novel:** FleekSort is an AI model fine-tuned on secondhand fashion, turning an opaque manual trade into a structured global inventory layer. This isn't a GPT wrapper.
- **The growth is exceptional:** Tripling year-on-year, ~$50M raised, Series B closed. Backed by a16z, Y Combinator, HV Capital, with advisors from Depop, Shopify, and Postmates.
- **The timing is perfect:** The secondhand market is projected to reach $350B by 2027, and creators are how resellers decide who to trust.
- **You'll have real ownership:** 100-person company, no bureaucracy. You'll own a channel end to end and see the impact of your work immediately.

## Our Values

Five values shape how we work at Fleek:

- **Dream Big and Disrupt Yourself:** Push the most ambitious version of what you're building. Step out of your comfort zone. Nothing is out of reach.
- **Absolute Ownership:** The buck stops with you. Drive initiatives to completion. Experiment, learn, persevere. The job isn't done until the job is done.
- **Curiosity Leads the Way:** Don't accept anything at face value. Ask questions you don't know the answer to. That's how you innovate.
- **Talk to the Customer:** Deeply understand their challenges, motivations, and ambitions. Every decision starts with the customer at the centre.
- **Embrace Diversity:** A global team building for a global supply chain. Bring your authentic self and embrace the diversity of everyone you encounter.

Ready to make Fleek the brand every reseller trusts? If you want to own our best acquisition channel end to end, run it on a genuinely AI-native engine, and see your wins in the company numbers within weeks, we'd love to hear from you.
